pois.name: Haven
pois.ask: CONFLICT: three sources place Haven differently. Here (north-west of Oakenshire) is where the buried Haven vendors and the Westwatch Training Yard stand; the layout sketch puts Haven south-west at the end of the river valley (pin 'Haven (south-west option)'); the continent sketch puts it south of Oakenshire. Keep one pin, delete the other, then confirm.

pois.name: The Hollow Choir (ruined abbey)
pois.ask: CONFLICT: q57 says the crypt stair is 'under the third mound' of the Barrowfield (about (-474, 227), 600 m west of this pin). Keep the abbey here and reword q57, move the abbey to the Barrowfield, or give the crypt two entrances? Then confirm.
pois.description: Entrance to map 1. Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): a ruined abbey with a bell tower visible from far, on a side path north-west of Oakenshire, off the beaten path; an overgrown path leads up from the valley. Your pin sits on the plateau edge at 29 m, next to the prototype Cylinder marker at (107, 345).

pois.name: North High Ridge
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): steep, rocky, little paths, leads to hunting areas. Terrain: the ring's north crest, 60-78 m.
pois.ask: Right stretch of ridge? Where should the little paths up from the basin start? Then confirm.

pois.name: Old Watchtower
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): ruined tower on the mountain ring around Oakenshire, good vantage point. Terrain: the ring's flat north-east summit, 83 m.
pois.ask: Name clash: zone 11 'Ruined Watchtower' is the Kingsroad bandit tower in the west. Keep both (rename one) or are they the same? Then confirm.

pois.name: High Ridge hunting grounds
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): hunting areas and hunting camps beyond the North High Ridge. Terrain: the plateau north of the ring, about 45 m.
pois.ask: Level band, and what is hunted here (and by whom)? Then confirm.

pois.name: Hidden cave
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): small cave on the mountain ring around Oakenshire (east), not obvious. Terrain: foot of the east cliff behind the town, 10 m.
pois.ask: Where does it lead (lair, smugglers, kobolds, mine)? Move it if it is too close to the town. Then confirm.

pois.name: Waterfall
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): waterfall on the mountain ring around Oakenshire (south-east), good landmark, herb spawns. Terrain: the south-east cliff above the boar grounds. No water exists here yet.
pois.ask: Inside the basin (here) or on the ring's outer south-east face as on the sketch? Where should its stream run? Then confirm.

pois.name: South Ridge quarry
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): South Ridge, rocky slopes, some lead to a quarry or mine. Terrain: foot of the south ridge, 25-35 m, right next to the Forest Bandit camp tents at (230-262, 762).
pois.ask: Is the bandit camp inside the old quarry (merge these) or is the quarry a separate, working place? Then confirm.

pois.name: Forward Outpost
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 3 - Forward Outpost, north-west across the river from the Forest Road.
pois.ask: Is this Briarwatch Camp or Barrowfront Camp (then delete this pin), or a new camp on the west bank (drag and confirm)?

pois.name: Old Stone Bridge
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 4 - Old Stone Bridge. Terrain: where the painted road meets the river (7 m deep); today a house (HouseTest) and two piers stand here.
pois.ask: Is this the crossing? A stone bridge prop is needed (today there are only piers). Then confirm.

pois.name: River Valley
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 5 - River Valley opens up; views get wider, terrain gets softer. Terrain: flat ground on both banks south of the bridge, no zone yet.
pois.ask: Name and level band of this stretch? Then confirm.

pois.name: Farmlands and Hamlets
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 6 - Farmlands & Hamlets in the valley. West of the river. Flat, empty ground today.
pois.ask: Hamlet name(s) and level band? Then confirm.

pois.name: Crossroads Inn
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 7 - Crossroads Inn on the Haven road. West of the river. Which roads cross here is open.
pois.ask: Which roads cross at the inn (the Northroad?), and its name? Then confirm.

pois.name: Haven (south-west option)
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 9 - Haven, the major city, south-west at the end of the river valley, west of the river's lower course.
pois.ask: CONFLICT: see the 'Haven' pin. If Haven goes here, confirm this and delete the other; otherwise delete this one.

pois.name: The river (unnamed)
pois.description: Terrain: a river 30-50 m wide and about 7 m deep running north-south at x -520 from z -450 to z 920, with a loop at its north end, a branch east at z 50 and a shallow ford (2 m) at z 150-200. The layout sketch has it west of Oakenshire, flowing south past Haven.
pois.ask: Name the river. Then confirm.

pois.name: The lake (unnamed)
pois.description: Terrain: a lake up to 23 m deep at x -1050..-650, z -270..80, north-west of everything else. On neither sketch.
pois.ask: Name it. What is it (a lake, a bay of the sea)? Then confirm.

pois.name: East of the ring: the wilds
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp) (side view): east of the mountain ring lie wilder, more dangerous areas; west lie the civilized lands (valley, Haven). No terrain is sculpted here yet.
